method: Reviewed registry source vendored with EPOS adaptations; CLI was not executed.
adaptations: Tailwind 3 compatible CSS using scoped EPOS semantic token aliases
Original animation, pointer interaction, layered input and refraction mechanisms retained
Accessible native props and existing EPOS form/modal semantics preserved
Reduced-motion, animation pause, ResizeObserver and browser API guards
Credit disclosure composes the glass panel with native button semantics; not an upstream popover
ShimmerButton adds neutral, ghost and destructive EPOS skins while preserving native handlers, refs and direct-child layout
MagicInput is the shared input default; HTML size, submit events and inline styles remain on the native input
MagicTab retains upstream layered selection and manual keyboard activation, adding tab/panel relationships and composed event handlers
LightRays retains the upstream conic fan, source glow and optional grain, adding a pause control and scoped color tokens
MagicButton retains the separate shadow, edge and lifted face, using restrained motion, opt-in rainbow, composed keyboard/blur handlers and a safe native button default

ProgressFoldButton retains the folded face, indeterminate sweep and controlled determinate fill; loading disables repeat submission, invalid percentages remain indeterminate, and EPOS supplies no invented progress. Progress semantics are outside the native button so assistive technology does not flatten them or change its accessible name
MetricCard and StatTile compose SpotlightCard around native links, buttons or static content; footer actions remain separate to avoid nested controls
deferred: GodUI command-palette, drawer, dropdown-menu, breadcrumbs and combobox require framer-motion. Existing navigation, modal logic, native select/textarea and data-heavy controls remain and are not claimed as upstream GodUI components. No new dependency was installed; shadcn adaptations have separate provenance.
